title: Calls land on any pod (no sticky sessions)
defence: Stateless server; shared state in Redis
tests: a quote created on one pod is served by another

title: Bob reads Alice's quote with her quote ID
defence: Redis key = tenant + user from the token + random ID

title: Money moves without asking the human
defence: MRTR confirmation before charging

title: Edited or replayed requestState
defence: HMAC-signed requestState, bound to the user, 5-minute expiry

title: Double charge after a dropped connection
defence: Redis SET NX lock + PayCo idempotency key
tests: 5 identical calls at the same moment

title: Shared cache leaks an admin's tool list
defence: cacheScope private + Cache-Control: private, no-store + Vary: Authorization
tests: every MCP response tells HTTP caches

title: WAF fooled by a header that lies
defence: SDK rejects header/body mismatch (-32020); WAF decides on headers

title: Another admin's report ID
defence: Report ID = owner-bound handle

title: Token issued for another app / user token forwarded downstream
defence: Audience check; InsureBot pays PayCo with its own key

title: Guessable IDs
defence: 192-bit random IDs

title: All-powerful tokens / anyone can ask for an admin scope
defence: Per-tool scopes + admin role checked by policy

title: Confused deputy through an OAuth proxy
defence: Not applicable: InsureBot is not an OAuth proxy to a third party

title: Prompt injection in a customer note tries to email data out
defence: No 'to' argument, fixed template, human confirmation, untrusted-text label, email-only-to-customer policy
tests: a note can't close the label early

title: Medical data leaks into chat, traces or logs
defence: Minimal outputs; argument names only in audit; no bodies or values in traces
tests: a trace of start_quote holds no diagnosis

title: SQL injection through a tool argument
defence: Parameterized queries, escaped LIKE wildcards

title: Runaway agent floods the server
defence: Per-agency rate limit in Redis, 429 + Retry-After

title: Agency taken from the model instead of the token
defence: Tenant from the token + Postgres RLS (ENABLE + FORCE)
tests: a buggy query with no WHERE

title: Command injection through an external program
defence: execFile with an argument array, format allowlist

title: "Who exported our data last night?"
defence: Append-only audit log + traces linked by trace_id
tests: insurebot_app can INSERT, but not read

title: Forgotten server without auth, secrets in Git, bad dependencies
defence: Shadow scan, refuse to start without auth, gitleaks, pinned images, lockfile check, tool fingerprints
tests: the tools InsureBot exposes match the reviewed manifest
